solution: $\\sin x+\\sin3x=2\\sin2x\\cos x$ and $\\cos x+\\cos3x=2\\cos2x\\cos x$. The equation becomes $2\\cos x(\\sin2x-\\cos2x)=0$. So either $\\cos x=0$ giving $x=\\pi/2,3\\pi/2$, or $\\sin2x=\\cos2x$ i.e. $\\tan2x=1$ giving $2x=\\pi/4,5\\pi/4,9\\pi/4,13\\pi/4$, so $x=\\pi/8,5\\pi/8,9\\pi/8,13\\pi/8$.
